title: 20-Minute Gentle Strength Workout for Seniors | Chair Support Option
promise: 20 minutes to work on your strength
description: A gentle 20-minute strength routine for seniors. Follow along at your own pace — a sturdy chair is all you need.

segments.name: March in Place
segments.instruction: Gently lift your knees
segments.say: Let's start by marching in place. Gently lift your knees.

segments.name: Shoulder Rolls
segments.instruction: Roll your shoulders back slowly
segments.say: Now, roll your shoulders back, slowly and smoothly.

segments.name: Arm Circles
segments.instruction: Make small circles with your arms
segments.say: Open your arms and make small, easy circles.

segments.name: Heel Raises
segments.instruction: Rise onto your toes, then lower slowly
segments.say: Hold your chair if you need it. Rise onto your toes, then lower slowly.

segments.instruction: Relax your shoulders and breathe
segments.say: Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Sit to Stand
segments.instruction: Stand up slowly, then sit back down
segments.say: Sit near the front of your chair. Stand up slowly, then sit back down with control.

segments.instruction: Relax your shoulders and breathe
segments.say: Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Wall Push-Ups
segments.instruction: Bend your elbows, then push away
segments.say: Facing a wall, place your hands on it. Bend your elbows, then push away.

segments.instruction: Relax your shoulders and breathe
segments.say: Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Side Leg Raises
segments.instruction: Lift your leg out to the side
segments.say: Hold your chair, and lift one leg out to the side. Slow and controlled.

segments.instruction: Relax your shoulders and breathe
segments.say: Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Seated Knee Lifts
segments.instruction: Lift one knee, then the other
segments.say: Sitting tall, lift one knee, then the other.

segments.instruction: Relax your shoulders and breathe
segments.say: Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Heel Raises (Round 2)
segments.instruction: Rise onto your toes, then lower slowly
segments.say: Hold your chair if you need it. Rise onto your toes, then lower slowly.

segments.instruction: Relax your shoulders and breathe
segments.say: Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Sit to Stand (Round 2)
segments.instruction: Stand up slowly, then sit back down
segments.say: Sit near the front of your chair. Stand up slowly, then sit back down with control.

segments.instruction: Relax your shoulders and breathe
segments.say: Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Wall Push-Ups (Round 2)
segments.instruction: Bend your elbows, then push away
segments.say: Facing a wall, place your hands on it. Bend your elbows, then push away.

segments.instruction: Relax your shoulders and breathe
segments.say: Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Side Leg Raises (Round 2)
segments.instruction: Lift your leg out to the side
segments.say: Hold your chair, and lift one leg out to the side. Slow and controlled.

segments.instruction: Relax your shoulders and breathe
segments.say: Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Seated Knee Lifts (Round 2)
segments.instruction: Lift one knee, then the other
segments.say: Sitting tall, lift one knee, then the other.

segments.instruction: Relax your shoulders and breathe
segments.say: Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Heel Raises (Round 3)
segments.instruction: Rise onto your toes, then lower slowly
segments.say: Hold your chair if you need it. Rise onto your toes, then lower slowly.

segments.instruction: Relax your shoulders and breathe
segments.say: Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Sit to Stand (Round 3)
segments.instruction: Stand up slowly, then sit back down
segments.say: Sit near the front of your chair. Stand up slowly, then sit back down with control.

segments.instruction: Relax your shoulders and breathe
segments.say: Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Wall Push-Ups (Round 3)
segments.instruction: Bend your elbows, then push away
segments.say: Facing a wall, place your hands on it. Bend your elbows, then push away.

segments.instruction: Relax your shoulders and breathe
segments.say: Take a short rest. Relax your shoulders, and breathe.

segments.name: Side Leg Raises (Round 3)
segments.instruction: Lift your leg out to the side
segments.say: Hold your chair, and lift one leg out to the side. Slow and controlled.

segments.name: Deep Breathing
segments.instruction: Breathe in through your nose
segments.say: Let's slow down. Breathe in through your nose, and out through your mouth.

segments.name: Calf Stretch
segments.instruction: Step back and press your heel down
segments.say: Step one foot back and gently press your heel down. Hold the stretch.

segments.name: Neck Stretch
segments.instruction: Tilt your head gently to the side
segments.say: Gently tilt your head to one side, then the other.
